cruxes.question: Does the hook or the politics have to land first?

sides.position: Politics is the topic, not the garnish

cruxes.question: Can lecture-only material honestly carry the frame?

sides.position: Yes, if it is flagged as ground, not gospel
The assigned text should lead its own week

note: The room agrees on the destination - students who can argue both what money is and whose politics Bitcoin encodes - and fights over which frame students meet first, and in whose voice.
